publication_scope: Published means the six companion assets are available from a read-only Drive folder. It does not assert public GitHub repository visibility, a tagged GitHub release, or paper acceptance.
transfer_verification: All six archives and the companion README were downloaded anonymously on 2026-09-28; every size and SHA-256 matched. See evidence/DOWNLOAD_VERIFICATION.json. Readers should verify their own copies; present byte integrity does not guarantee scientific correctness or future link permanence.
meaning: These archives contain recorded experiment outputs and supporting provenance, including attributed dataset-derived contexts. They are not substitutes for acquiring the original datasets. Exact saved-data reanalysis requires matching assets; new runs use source code and separately acquired original inputs.

assets.purpose: Recorded Workstation 1 Windows policy, dataset, sensitivity, processing, scaling and load outcomes; historical university identifiers are preserved.

regeneration.note: The frozen Windows protocol can create a new run. It cannot recreate the original timestamps, machine state or byte-identical timing observations.

assets.purpose: Recorded Workstation 2 Windows regeneration, policy, dataset, sensitivity, processing, scaling and load outcomes; historical workstation identifiers are preserved.

regeneration.note: The frozen Windows protocol can create a new run. Compare deterministic outputs separately from environment-dependent timing and load measurements.

assets.purpose: Qualification and 36 completed initial packet episodes from the primary VM on Workstation 2.

regeneration.note: Use the included packet-v7 snapshot in an authorized isolated VM. The packet protocol uses controlled lab traffic, not a NetsLab or 5G-NIDD traffic replay.

assets.purpose: Qualification and the identical 36-episode protocol in a separately installed clean VM on the same Workstation 2.

regeneration.note: Install a separate clean VM and repeat the same source, conditions and seed. This is clean-environment reproduction, not an independent physical-workstation replication.

assets.purpose: Historical Stage 0 baselines, Stage 4 workload preparation and campaign regeneration/orchestration records for both workstations.

regeneration.note: A new campaign creates new source/input receipts and workload comparisons. Historical receipts, dates and original host state cannot be regenerated.

assets.purpose: Optional historical packet qualification attempts, failure evidence and repair context, separated from completed comparative episodes.

regeneration.note: Past failures and operator actions cannot be recreated as historical evidence. Use final v7 for new experiments; do not deliberately rerun obsolete attempts.
